+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock, patch
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux import LinuxNetwork, LinuxNetworkCollector
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_normalized_and_sorted():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, '''local 192.168.1.1/24 dev lo table 100 scope host
+local 127.0.0.1 dev lo table local scope host
+local 192.168.0.1 dev lo table local scope host
+local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo table local scope host
+local 192.168.1.0/24 dev lo table local scope host
+broadcast 192.168.1.255 dev eth0 table local scope link
+unreachable 10.0.0.0/8 dev lo scope host
+10.1.1.0/24 dev lo scope host
+local bad-address dev lo scope host
+''', ''),
+        (0, '''local 2001:0db8::1/64 dev lo table 100
+local ::1 dev lo table local
+local 2001:db8::/64 dev lo table 100 scope host
+local 2001:db8::2 dev lo table local scope host
+''', ''),
+    ]
+
+    result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/usr/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {
+        'ipv4': ['10.1.1.0/24', '127.0.0.0/8', '127.0.0.1', '192.168.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24'],
+        'ipv6': ['::1', '2001:db8::/64', '2001:db8::2'],
+    }
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list[0][0][0] == [
+        '/usr/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'all', 'scope', 'host']
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list[1][0][0] == [
+        '/usr/sbin/ip', '-6', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'all', 'scope', 'host']
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_failed_family_keeps_other_family():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, 'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host\n', ''),
+        (1, '', 'IPv6 is disabled'),
+    ]
+
+    result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/usr/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': []}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Cannot collect locally reachable ipv6 routes')
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_without_ipv6_support():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host\n', '')
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', False):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/usr/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': []}
+    assert module.run_command.call_count == 1
+
+
+def test_populate_exposes_locally_reachable_ips():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/usr/sbin/ip'
+    network = LinuxNetwork(module)
+    network.get_default_interfaces = Mock(return_value=({}, {}))
+    network.get_interfaces_info = Mock(return_value=({}, {
+        'all_ipv4_addresses': [], 'all_ipv6_addresses': []}))
+    network.get_locally_reachable_ips = Mock(return_value={
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': ['::1']})
+
+    result = network.populate()
+
+    assert result['locally_reachable_ips'] == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': ['::1']}
+    assert 'locally_reachable_ips' in LinuxNetworkCollector().fact_ids
+
+
+def test_populate_without_ip_exposes_empty_lists():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+
+    result = LinuxNetwork(module).populate()
+
+    assert result == {'locally_reachable_ips': {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Cannot collect locally reachable IPs: ip command is unavailable')
